title: Sanctus (Piéton, Missa In te Domini speravi)
desc: Loyset Piéton, Missa In te Domini speravi, Sanctus. 5 voices (Superius I, Superius II, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
